narrative: NVIDIA's Secure Agent Workspace reference design, bundled with the Azure-hosted Claude GA in Foundry, wraps autonomous agents in enterprise identity, networking and governance controls, signaling vendor convergence on governed agent execution. But "ships zero-trust controls as default-on" needs a named agent-platform release enforcing deny-by-default per-tenant authorization or default egress allowlisting. A reference design attached to an inference launch is adjacent context, not that shipped default-on gate.
remaining_gap: No named agent-platform release whose default profile enforces deny-by-default per-tenant authorization or default egress allowlisting.
